items.title: Selecting Features and Target Values (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Selecting Features and Target Values' under topic 6.6 (PDF 84, printed 80).

blocks.text: Features woh input values hain jo model istemal karta hai. Target values woh outputs hain jin ka andaza lagana hai. Sahi features chunne se seekhna behtar hota hai, aur ghair zaroori features accuracy kam kar sakte hain. Features masle se juray hue (relevant) hone chahiyen, aur target values saaf tay honi chahiyen. Misal: talaba ke marks ka andaza lagate waqt parhai ke ghante feature hain aur marks target value.
